name: route_status_tuple_lq1300_20261108
comment: LQ-20261107-1300: a ROUTES handler that returns (status, body) has its status honoured by the dispatcher; /api/v2/finviz-chart is the only such route and answers 502 with ok:false when the Finviz cookie is dead (a 302 login bounce is named 'cookie expired'), while every payload return keeps the v2 {ok, data} envelope.
